soal: 1. Joshua is holding a phone. What will Joshua do?
pilihan: A. He will read a book.
C. He will call his friend.

soal: 2. The boy is playing football in the yard. What will he do?
pilihan: A. He will kick the ball.
B. He will read a book.
C. He will clean the yard.
D. He will water the plants.

soal: 3. A man is painting the wall. What will he do?
pilihan: A. He will clean the house.
B. He will paint the wall.
C. He will fix the door.
D. He will water the plants.

soal: 4. Aisyah is ironing clothes. What will Aisyah do?
pilihan: D. She will sweep the floor.

soal: 5. A woman is cooking in the kitchen. What will she do?
pilihan: A. She will clean the kitchen.
B. She will wash the dishes.

soal: 6. An old woman is reading at home. What will she do?
pilihan: B. She will read a book.

soal: 7. A boy is listening to music with headphones. What will he do?
pilihan: A. He will sing a song.
C. He will listen to music.

soal: 8. Two girls are playing with a hoop. What will they do?
pilihan: C. They will clean the room.

soal: 9. Two boys are talking happily. What will they do?
10. A boy is flying a kite in a wheelchair. What will he do?
pilihan: B. He will fly a kite.
C. He will ride a bike.
D. He will draw a picture.

soal: 11. “I think Made will kick the ball.” What will Made do?
pilihan: A. He will read a book.
B. He will kick the ball.
C. He will clean the yard.

soal: 12. “I think Cici ____.” She is washing clothes.
13. “I think Aisyah ____.” She is reading a book.
14. “I think Bu Neneng ____.” She is cooking in the kitchen.
15. “I think Cici and Aisyah ____.” They are wearing traditional clothes.
16. “I think Lili ____.” She is watching television.
17. Where will Cici and her friends go next Sunday?
18. How will they go to Dufan?
19. What will they buy to enter Dufan?
20. What will Aisyah play at Dufan?
21. A boy is watering the flowers. What will he do?
pilihan: A. He will wash the car.
B. He will water the flowers.
D. He will read a book.

soal: 22. A girl is cleaning the classroom. What will she do?
pilihan: A. She will clean the classroom.
D. She will ride a bicycle.

soal: 23. "I think Budi ____." He is riding a bicycle.
24. Where will Cici and her friends have lunch after playing at Dufan?
25. What will they do after they arrive home from Dufan?
pilihan: A. They will do their homework.
B. They will take a rest.
D. They will go to school.
